findings.evidence: Title identifies Basanta Kumari Patnaik’s novel and Gopal Chhotray as dramatist; dedication addresses the novelist.
Chhotray recalls a half-hour version broadcast by Cuttack radio in May1954. Encouragement led to preparing the stage play. He thanks Samuel Sahu and the performers.
findings.limit: Not a separately inspected broadcast schedule or an independently measured audience response.
